_docs.REGION_NAME: Name of the single region offered to clients in the get-regions reply. Default: local
_docs.BEACON_URL: Host the client pings to measure region latency. Default: the value of GAME_SERVER_HOST
_docs.GAME_SERVER_HOST: IPv4 literal sent in session-started (the client does no DNS; hostnames are rejected and fall back to 127.0.0.1). Default: 127.0.0.1
_docs.GAME_SERVER_PORT: Game server UDP port sent in session-started. Default: 7777
_docs.MIN_PLAYERS: Queued players needed to start a match right away. Default: 1 (so a solo player can test)
_docs.QUEUE_TIMEOUT: Seconds after which a match starts with whoever is queued (at least 1 player). Default: 20
_docs.MATCH_BATCH_MS: Milliseconds to wait once a match is possible so near-simultaneous players share a session. Default: 300
_docs.LATE_JOIN_SECONDS: How long a matchmade session keeps accepting newly queued players. Default: 60
_docs.env: Every key can also be set with an environment variable named OGSOS_<KEY>, e.g. OGSOS_GAME_SERVER_HOST. Env wins over this file. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_docs.classic: SOS: Classic (app-id sostest) options. EXTRA_ROLES: roles added for every Classic login (everyone already gets app-user, user, testserver). DEV_ACCOUNTS: account ids or Steam ids that also get the dev role (Director button, server browser). Any matchmaking key above may be repeated here to override it for Classic only (e.g. GAME_SERVER_PORT for a Classic host); env OGSOS_CLASSIC_<KEY> also works. Classic live config is served from data/kv-classic/. HOSTS (Classic only here, or env OGSOS_CLASSIC_HOSTS as a JSON string): fixed game hosts, see docs/CLASSIC.md "MMS session routes for a hosted server"; with it set, matchmade players join the host's fixed session instead of a new one.
